basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of San Francisco’s desirable Hayes Valley neighborhood, this unit offers a blend of historic charm and modern convenience. The open-concept layout maximizes space, while large windows fill the home with natural light, creating a warm and inviting ambiance. Enjoy a stylish kitchen equipped with modern appliances, ample storage, and sleek finishes, perfect for both cooking and entertaining. The unit’s location provides easy access to nearby boutique shopping, popular dining spots, and vibrant city parks. The property has been remodeled with all necessary permits. Square footage and bed/bath counts are estimates and not guaranteed by the seller or listing agent.
